Brant thanks the audience for their support and invites you all to stay tuned for more dazzling performances from the Troupe of Fools!
Brant promises to pull out all the stops in the final, so be ready for a show you won't forget!
Brant says that the finest sailors are just as comfortable on land as fish in water, and don't forget to keep supporting the Troupe of Fools, savvy?
Brant suggests adding a little extra prize money to make the competition more exciting.
Congratulations to Brant for taking first place! He hopes his performance left you grinning, and of course, keep supporting the Troupe of Fools!
Changli says she competes to make new friends, share ideas, and keep pushing herself to grow.
Changli is honored to compete with such great contenders and will give her all in the upcoming matches.
In a pre-race interview, Changli admits she isn't particularly skilled at racing, but she's joining in for the experience.
Changli regrets seeing some strong competitors get knocked out and hopes for a rematch in the future!
Congratulations to Changli for taking first place! She humbly credits her win to luck.
Camellya says that the contenders are so boring that she's almost falling asleep!
Camellya declares that now that she's reached the final round, she will no longer hold back and will tear it up!
Camellya declined our pre-race interview, stating that only winners have the right to speak.
Camellya states there are no secrets to victory. Strength is the only way.
Congratulations to Camellya for taking first place! She says she had a blast and can't wait for the next race to begin!
Phoebe shares her secret to victory: "T-T-There's really no secret!"
Phoebe was so shocked to make it to the final that she froze right in the middle of the interview. How adorable!
We now bring you Phoebe's blessings: she hopes everyone enjoys the race and does their best!
Phoebe wishes the eliminated contenders all the best for their next chance to shine!
Congratulations to Phoebe for taking first place! She attributes her success to the blessing of the Sentinel.
Jinhsi shares her winning secret: "The key is to maintain your pace and breathing. Master the rhythm, and you'll master the race."
Jinhsi is grateful for the luck that got her to the finals. Now she's ready to team up with the other Resonators and bring it all home!
Jinhsi has earned widespread praise for her achievements as Magistrate. What kind of performance will she bring as a contender?
Jinhsi says every contender has their own strengths. A few races aren't enough to call it just yet!
Congratulations to Jinhsi for taking first place! She says everyone's support gave her the strength to win.
Calcharo states that those obsessed with "secrets to victory" don't tend to live long.
Calcharo says he will not be making any special preparations for the final, as he gives his all in every race.
Unfortunately, Calcharo declined our interview. We wish him the best of luck in the competition!
Calcharo declines to comment on the eliminated contenders.
Congratulations to Calcharo for taking first place! Sadly, our crew couldn't track him down after the race. Truly a mysterious competitor.
Cantarella shares a list of "nutritious" foods to boost race performance... but, uh, are these really what you'd call "nutritious"?
Cantarella warns that any contender who made it to the final should not be underestimated, so she plans to up the dosage accordingly… Wait, what dosage?!
Cantarella wishes everyone a wonderful time and reminds them to stay safe during the race.
Cantarella offers an elixir that promises to bring championship-winning dreams to those eliminated… and it has virtually no side effects!
Congratulations to Cantarella for taking first place! She says it was truly an enjoyable experience, and it was never about winning or losing.
After her victory in the last round, Cartethyia shares her secret: "Just run, run, and keep running. Don't let anyone pass you!"
Cartethyia declined our interview, saying she needs to fully focus on preparing for the final!
Cartethyia says that she's fully prepared and promises to put on an exciting show for the audience with her fellow contenders!
Cartethyia says she's happy to have a friendly match with any eliminated contenders who didn't get to enjoy the race to the fullest!
Congratulations to Cartethyia for taking first place! But it looks like she wasn't done running. Our camera crew couldn't keep up with her!
Carlotta shares that her secret to victory lies in maintaining passion and thirst for glory.
Carlotta feels fortunate to have made it to the final and announces that, regardless of the final ranking, the Montelli family will be offering commemorative gifts to all contenders.
Carlotta wishes for a smooth commencement of the race, and the event organizers extend their gratitude for her generous sponsorship of the competition.
Carlotta looks forward to seeing each contender's performance, believing every one of them has untapped potential!
Congratulations to Carlotta for taking first place! And special thanks for the gifts. Keep up the great work, Carlotta!
Roccia reveals that her secret to victory is keeping Pero's belly full.
Roccia says Pero is hungry! Spectators, feel free to toss anything you don't need her way!
As a contender known for using power-up items, what kind of surprises will Roccia bring to the race this time?
Roccia encourages the eliminated contenders not to feel down and to cheer on the ones still racing!
Congratulations to Roccia for taking first place! We now have her partner, Pero, on camera: "Pero. Pero, Pero!"
Shorekeeper explains that since Cubes are mostly starch, too much sweat can make them break down. The trick to winning is keeping your body temperature and shape steady.
Based on race data, Shorekeeper suggests thrill seekers bet on the more explosive contenders, while those who play it safe might want to back endurance racers like herself.
Shorekeeper says everyone adapts to the Cube form differently. It's not that she has better physical abilities than those eliminated. She's just better at being a Cube.
KU-Lolo mentions the last time Shorekeeper prepared this much was to welcome Rover to the Black Shores. Let's all look forward to her performance in the race!
Shorekeeper says she enjoys racing alongside others on an uncertain track more than knowing the outcome ahead of time.
Aemeath thoroughly enjoyed the competition and has decided to put on a live show for the contestants and audience alike after the Final.
Augusta secured an effortless victory. It seems the competition was merely a small hunt for someone of her stature.
Denia is somewhat surprised that she wasn't eliminated in the Preliminary, though she chalks it up to a bit of luck.
When asked about her plans after her win in the Preliminary, Hiyuki stated that she would like to rest and eat something, preferably with a cup of fine tea.
Phrolova has emerged victorious! Unfortunately, she left immediately after the match, so we were unable to complete our post-match interview.
Easy peasy! Lynae's flashing a victory sign at the camera. We're all looking forward to her next showing!
Luuk Herssen demonstrated precise control during the match, which he attributes to the muscle memory developed from years of performing surgery.
Mornye says she's quite used to hovering in the air. Her fondness for flight may well be the secret to her outstanding performance.
When asked about her post-match plans, Chisa said she'd be going to the Spacetrek Archive to look up some research papers.
Sigrika is deeply grateful for everyone's support, and she has stated that she will achieve great results in the next match as well.
Iuno claims that winning is a breeze, and the result is obvious even without a prophecy.
Before the match begins, Aemeath sends her best to all Fleet Snowfluff fans, stating that she definitely won't let them down.
Augusta is fully prepared for the match and will storm the field with the force of a thunderbolt!
Denia doesn't think she has a chance of winning... She just wanted to do her best to make it to the finish line.
Hiyuki declined our interview, stating that she would like to meditate in peace before the match.
When interviewed, Phrolova would not reveal her reasons for participating in the Derby and declared that her actions in cube form are not representative of her real self.
Lynae appears completely unfazed. She's here to kick ass and chew bubblegum!
Luuk Herssen is in a remarkably calm and positive mindset before the match. He's stated that he simply intends to do his best.
Mornye's initial concerns about her prosthetic legs proved unnecessary given her cube form. She's ready to compete as best as possible.
Chisa was reading a mystery novel an hour before the match, so the interview team decided not to bother her.
Sigrika's parents sent her a good luck package before the match. To honor their expectations, she is determined to compete at her absolute best.
Iuno declared that she will charge at the finish line, moonlight in arms.
Aemeath states that she is fully prepared for the next match. We can't wait to see her in action.
Augusta is the first across the finish line! Let's give a huge cheer for yet another victory!
Denia has delivered another outstanding performance! She rather modestly remarked that luck was on her side again. Perhaps she really is the "chosen one" of the course!
Hiyuki won the Eliminator with ease. It looks like she's still holding back. You don't want to miss what she'll bring to the next match.
Phrolova remarked that defeating her "rivals" has brought her a fleeting sense of satisfaction. She hopes to lead a climactic movement for everyone during the next match.
Lynae is thrilled with her own performance and plans to go all out in the next match. She even mentioned something about a special surprise for the audience.
Luuk Herssen was not at all surprised by his win. But he does feel that he could have done even better.
Mornye stated after the match that she really needed a triple-strength Instant Wakeup Energy Gel Sachet.
Chisa notes that she knows how to find her way through a labyrinth, citing her experience in Honami City. In her view, that was the key to her success today.
Sigrika says she finds this competition easy because she spends all day chasing Exoswarm.
Iuno is pleased with her showing. She noted that the Moonring's flight speed is still a bit on the slow side, else she would've finished even sooner.
Aemeath credits her superhuman pace to her younger days spent chasing Snowfluff Seals.
Augusta believes there are no shortcuts to victory. The only way to win is through relentless training and endless fighting.
We've heard from a reliable source that Denia is currently preparing for the match and is not in the locker room. Let's turn our cameras to the other contestants.
In her interview, Hiyuki shared her daily sword practice routine. The event organizers kindly remind you: for safety reasons, please do not attempt these yourself.

Phrolova may not be on the best of terms with the other contestants, so the event organizers provided her with a private locker room. Melodious strains of violin can always be heard emanating from within.
Lynae claims that given her past training, these contestants don't stand a chance. When pressed for details, she suddenly developed selective hearing and changed the subject. How suspicious!
Luuk Herssen has kindly offered medical aid and mental health support to those eliminated from the match. The event organizers extend their thanks for his generosity.
According to a few keen-eyed spectators, Mornye spent the entire night before the match de-stressing by calculating her odds of winning.
Chisa cooked up a Lemon-Scented Sukiyaki in the locker room and shared her delicious meal with the other contestants.
Sigrika states that she will redouble her efforts in the Eliminator. With the help of Soliskin, she's certain she'd win.
Iuno declined to be interviewed, saying she wanted to get a good night's sleep before the match.
Inspired by her win, Aemeath is set to write a song about this competition. We can't wait to hear it!
Victory belongs to Augusta! She has nothing but high praise for the iron resolve and formidable strength shown by all participants. She looks forward to competing with them once more.
Denia has claimed victory in the Final! In her acceptance speech, she thanked her friends at Startorch Academy, whose support made it possible for her to reach this far.
Huge congratulations to Hiyuki for coming out on top! She's dedicated to perfecting her skills and aims to create more miracles in the years to come.
Phrolova has been crowned Champion! There was a flash of delight on her face before she reverted to her expressionless demeanor as if nothing had ever happened.
Congratulations to Lynae, our new Champion! In other news, event organizers quickly confiscated her spray paint right after she pulled out a can. A real pity, if you ask me.
Congratulations to Luuk Herssen on winning the Final! During his interview, he says he'll donate the prize money to children in need.
Congratulations to Mornye for placing first in the competition! Mornye remarked that while this outcome didn't exactly match her calculations, life is always full of surprises.
Congratulations to Chisa on her victory! After thanking her fellow competitors, a mysterious capybara showed up with victory snacks for her.

Congratulations to Sigrika on becoming the Champion! In her interview, Sigrika thanked her family and friends in the Roya tribe, her classmates and teachers at Startorch Academy, as well as the Soliskin and Exoswarm... Let's give a round of applause for her victory!
Congratulations to Juno on her championship victory! May her glory endure forever, as timeless as the moonlight.
Aemeath hopes that her victory will make someone out there proud.

Augusta believes that future Agons should include elements of the Derby. It would keep certain gladiators from relying too much on Fortes and combat techniques while neglecting basic strength and endurance training.
Denia looks incredibly nervous at the starting line of the Final! Let's wait to see how the results unfold!
In her pre-Final interview, Hiyuki stated that she did not attempt to draw upon a future where she is victorious. She values the experience itself more than the outcome.
Phrolova says the time is ripe to bring her grand performance to its dramatic conclusion!
Lynae has declared that if she wins the Final, she'll spray paint a giant portrait of herself on the course. So far, the event organizers have declined to comment on the matter.
Luuk Herssen says eating candy before a match is his secret to excellent performance.
Mornye told us in an interview that despite not being particularly athletic, she's more than willing to demonstrate the might of the Spacetrek Collective techs.
Speaking after her victory, Chisa said she'd like to return to a certain cafe and hang a photo of her victory on the wall.
Sigrika believes everyone who made it to the Final is incredibly strong, and that she's starting to feel the pressure...
Sticking to hunting tradition, Iuono performed a small divination ritual before the match. She's not one to blindly follow fate, but it seems to have strengthened her belief in victory.
What a brilliant performance! Let's give a big round of applause to Aemeath!
Augusta feels she still has work to do and says she'll be back in the competition as soon as she's fully prepared.
Changli emerged victorious in the Showmatch. She hopes that by the next Derby, she will have formulated a more formidable winning strategy.
Denia was outstanding in the Showmatch! She remarked that next time, she'll show us her true abilities. Can't wait to see what she's really capable of!

The Land of Xuanfang is rich in jade resources. Locals view the Jadeplume Eagle as a spiritual creature coexisting with jade, thus protecting it fiercely. If a fallen jade egg is found in the mountains, people will try to return it to its nest. Only those eggs confirmed to be abandoned by the parent birds, with nowhere to return, are treated as extra gifts from the wilderness and carefully utilized. After the chicks safely hatch, the remaining jade-calcified shells are imbued with even higher value. People carve them into ornaments and gift them to children, embedding a blessing for them to "spread their wings and soar high."
Uncracked Jade

Climber Shoots

Hard and exceptionally dense, the Jade Hexahedron is a superb energy-conducting medium, frequently mined for use in mechanics and residential construction. Jade Hexahedron

The White Jade Beauty is difficult to preserve. Once touched or bruised, the damaged area rapidly oozes a striking cyan-blue hue, resembling a clouded jewel or a cracked jade plate. \nThough delicious, it is mildly toxic. Eating it raw causes severe dizziness and vomiting, so it must be fully cooked before consumption. To ensure safety, eateries often take diners' utensils away while the mushrooms are cooking to prevent them from sneaking a premature bite.
White Jade Beauty

A mushroom that grows in damp woodlands. Because its entire body resembles pure jade and its veil drapes down like a flowing dress of snowy gauze, giving it an exquisite, delicate grace, it earned the name "White Jade Beauty."

Every Opus Stone is made thanks to the rigorous selection process of the Opus Otter. Uncut stones with dull acoustics or messy textures are discarded along the water's edge, becoming "Otter Castaways" occasionally found by travelers. \nThe people of Mengzhou carefully polish Opus Stones of varying pitches, crafting them into lithophones and wind chimes hung beneath eaves or by the water. Whenever the chimes ring, nearby Opus Otters often pause their work to listen closely; if the mood strikes them, they will even strike their own stones in harmony, as if playing a duet with a kindred spirit.
Opus Stone
A natural instrument carried by the Opus Otter. Every individual stone produces a distinct musical note.

The Leafweaver has a delicate frame and a pale golden hue. As a "professional," it cuts leaves or petals to construct intricately designed, spiral tower-like nests. On sunny afternoons in the Land of Xuanfang, one can often spot busy Leafweavers fluttering through the air, carrying leaves several times larger than their own bodies.
Leafweaver
The nest of the chirping Leafweaver insect. Meticulously structured, it is primarily built from leaves and flower petals.
A material used for Synthesis.

The outer layer of black jade on the Floral Crest Jade is incredibly hard and dense. The Twistscale often uses its own scales to repeatedly grind the jade's surface. Once the stone is polished as smooth as a mirror and gleaming brightly, the outer layer peels away evenly, revealing the fully intact, vivid "jade chrysanthemum" within. Treasuring its elegant patterns, the people of Mengzhou often place Twistscale-polished Floral Crest Jades in their homes as exquisite desk ornaments.
Floral Crest Jade
A chrysanthemum-shaped crystal found within jade. Elegant and unfurling, it is hailed as the "noble guest within the stone."

In the Land of Xuanfang, the Cloudperch Seed is seen as the embodiment of weightlessness and lofty ambitions. Whenever the late autumn winds begin to blow, the tree's "perching feathers" rustle in unison, breaking free from the branches to dance gracefully through the valleys. Borne on mountain breezes and thermal currents, these seeds can travel immense distances. Only when the wind finally subsides do the winged seeds touch down gently, scattering life across distant lands.
Cloudperch Seed
The seed of the Cloudperch Tree. Its opposing bracts spread open widely, resembling a pair of wings resting upon a branch.

Drawing the twilight's glow, gathering radiance upon scales.\nThe Flowborne Dream is exceptionally sensitive to environmental shifts. The shimmering changes in its scales and its swimming patterns can detect ecological imbalances in a given area faster than any crafted device. Consequently, the people of Mengzhou often keep them in wall-mounted glass tanks draped with thin silk scroll paintings. Beyond mere decoration, they serve as a natural early-warning instrument.
Flowborne Dream
An auspicious koi fish native to Mengzhou. Exquisitely shaped with multicolored scales, it resembles a living landscape painting woven in gold and green.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

With its sword-like leaves and crisp, refreshing scent, the Blade Blossom has historically been imbued with the folkloric meaning of "warding off evil with sword leaves" by the people of Mengzhou. Every midsummer, locals gather its straight, long leaves and hang them alongside mugwort on doorframes and windows, believing they can cleave away impurities and repel misfortune. Its tendency to bloom under the moonlight and scatter its blade-like petals in the wind is viewed as a profoundly pure, fleeting purification ritual—wherever the petals drift, all gloom seems washed away.
Blade Blossom
A white flower that grows by the water, blooming only at night. Its slender leaves and layered, blade-like petals make it look like a sword abruptly drawn in the dark of night.

The egg noodles Yangyang makes carry the taste of her mother from her memories.

Back in her hometown, Yangyang's schedule was always packed to the brim. Because she could not yet see a clear picture of her future, she constantly tried to squeeze out every second of her time, desperate to add any possible edge to her path forward. Yet whenever Yangyang finished her music lessons and walked home under the starlit night, a steaming bowl of egg noodles would always be waiting for her on the table. Of course, sometimes there would be two bowls, which meant her father had also worked late into the night. And sometimes, there would be three, because her older sister, who was supposed to be fast asleep, would inevitably catch the scent of the noodles and coax her mother into making her a midnight meal.

To Yangyang, that bowl of egg noodles from her memory represents home, love, and the warmth and happiness melted into everyday life.

It is the flavor that has supported her all the way to where she is now, and the exact taste she wishes to pass on to someone special someday.
The Secret of Delicacy
